race.comment: DEI MIRACOLI (1) will find this a little easier than his second on debut two weeks ago over 1200m at Wagga. Has a wide gate to overcome but he will be hard to beat. FLYING BETTY (6) ran on strongly but just failed to pick up the winner last start when second over 1150m at Leeton. This is the right race and she can play a major role. PIERATA STAR (2) didn't make an impact at his last run before going for a spell on May 26, finishing ninth over 1400m at Albury. Can make his presence felt. SURREAL GRACE (8) improved a little finishing midfield last start at Corowa when jumping at big odds, could add some value to betting.
